title: Weird and mysterious words stories vs science words stories on points
question: Does a story about weird and mysterious words get more points than a story about science words?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about weird and mysterious words gets more points than a story about science words.
expect: If true, points per story for weird and mysterious words stories should be at least 1.5x the value for science words stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, weird and mysterious words against science words

group_a.label: Weird and mysterious words stories ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h354 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h354 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
